Question: How many polynomials of the form \(x^5 + ax^4 + bx^3 + cx^2 + dx\) \(+ 2020,\) where \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c,\) and \(d\) are real numbers, have the property that whenever \(r\) is a root, so is \(\dfrac{-1 + i\sqrt3}{2}\cdot r?\) (Note that \(i = \sqrt{-1}.\))
